question: Across the episode, at which of the following moments does Joey appear most joyful or excited?
options: A. Joey hangs up the phone after his agent calls and tells the group about a new Al Pacino movie.
B. Joey sits in the apartment after his friends comfort him about losing the movie role.
C. Joey reads aloud the talent-agency card an usher left for him after the show.
D. Joey borrows Monica's moisturizer to get ready in the bathroom on the morning of his shoot.

question: Across the episode, at which of the following moments does Chandler appear most excited or happy?
options: A. Chandler returns to his friends after speaking with Aurora and tells them her answer.
B. Chandler begins telling the group at the coffee house about his first date with Aurora.
C. Chandler gathers a few things at Monica's apartment before going to see Aurora again.
D. Chandler lies beside Aurora during their second date before she says she has to leave.

question: Across the episode, at which of the following moments does Monica appear most visibly irritated?
options: A. Monica notices that Rachel has moved the green ottoman and puts it back in its old place.
B. Monica lies awake in bed, unable to stop thinking about the shoes left in the living room.
C. Monica objects when Chandler says he will continue seeing Aurora despite her other partners.
D. Monica listens as Chandler describes condensation from a cold drink reaching the coffee table.

question: Which description best captures Chandler's emotional trajectory from insisting that he has no resentment about Aurora to the aftermath of ending their arrangement?
options: A. He begins calm and confident, shows controlled jealousy, becomes animated as his conflict surfaces, and ends disappointed and frustrated.
B. He begins calm and confident, shifts into open anger, becomes animated as his conflict surfaces, and ends disappointed and frustrated.
C. He begins calm and confident, shows controlled jealousy, becomes quiet and withdrawn as his conflict surfaces, and ends disappointed and frustrated.
D. He begins calm and confident, shows controlled jealousy, becomes animated as his conflict surfaces, and ends relieved and calm.
